أنتقي (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِي (ʔantaqī) /ʔan.ta.qiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# أَنْتَقِيَ (ʔantaqiya) /ʔan.ta.qi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
